original_input: What does assister à une réunion mean?
original_context: Learning note: Assister à une réunion means to attend a meeting, not to assist the meeting. The preposition à belongs to this use. Synthetic practice discussion.
discussion_summary: Learning note: Assister à une réunion means to attend a meeting, not to assist the meeting. The preposition à belongs to this use. Synthetic practice discussion.

analysis.explanation: Assister à means to attend an event; it is a false friend of English assist.
